plugin.name: Calendar
plugin.description: Cross-project calendar, tasks, reminders, and file links.
view.sidebar.name: Calendar
view.main.name: Calendar
tool.calendar_agenda.description: List calendar items (deadlines, hearings, meetings, to-dos) across all projects the user can see within a date range, each with its project name. Use it for questions like 'what is due this week'.
tool.calendar_create.description: Create a calendar item (deadline, hearing, meeting or to-do) in a project; it then appears in the project calendar.
